title: Gnarly zone connections
description: Building-level links between nodes in different zones (each zone is one ARWorldMap, and a staircase is its own zone). Connections are bidirectional and have A* weight 1.

zoneId.description: Zone whose building.json contains the node.

nodeId.description: Node id in that zone's graph (building.json node id, or a RoomPlan-derived id such as stairs-1a2b3c4d).
